_summary.text: Built for AI. From the silicon up.

_detail.text: For everyone from students to small business owners to creative professionals, MacBook Air with M5 is designed to leverage AI in everyday workflows while preserving your privacy. Whether using powerful Apple Intelligence features across apps and macOS, running LLMs on your Mac, or vibe coding, you’ll stay productive — and protected.

_name.text: AI apps on Mac. Born to run.

_detail.text: Mac is optimized to handle AI apps — like ChatGPT, LM Studio, Msty Studio, Topaz Video, and Topaz Photo — so you can learn faster, think in new ways, and get more done.

_name.text: AI tools in apps. Mac makes magic.

_detail.text: Use intelligent tools to unlock new levels of productivity and creativity — from editing images in Adobe Photoshop to rendering 3D models in Shapr3D to creating films in Final Cut Pro.

_name.text: Apple Intelligence. Do more. Effort less.

_detail.text: Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple.

_name.text: Great powers come with great privacy.

_detail.text: Apple Intelligence is designed to protect your privacy at every step. It’s integrated into the core of your Mac through on-device processing. So it’s aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. And with groundbreaking Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can draw on larger server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests for you while protecting your privacy.

_lines._intent: macOS 章节：Spotlight、Liquid Glass、控制中心与实时翻译四项能力

_detail.text: macOS is designed to support the way you work, create, and connect, with powerful apps and seamless multitasking.
Perform hundreds of actions on your MacBook Air — from finding files and apps to quickly sending a message — all within Spotlight.

The stunning new design with Liquid Glass brings even more clarity to navigation and controls, and unlocks more ways to personalize your experience. Take your icons from light to dark, or choose an alluring clear look.

_name.text: What you want, right where you want it.

_detail.text: The controls you use most, like window tiling, screenshots, and accessing your favorite apps, can be personalized in Control Center. A transparent design keeps your display open and uncluttered.
Communicate effortlessly across languages. Instantly translate texts in Messages, display live translated captions in FaceTime, and get real-time spoken translations in the Phone app.

_lines._intent: Continuity 章节：Mac 与 iPhone 协同的五项能力（原 `_items` 误标为可互换实例：五项能力不同形——首项只有名、其余名+述，引擎已自愈成序列；回改为 `_lines` 有序序列）

_detail.text: Mac and iPhone are incredible on their own. But when you use them together, they work wonders. Thanks to Continuity features, you can move seamlessly across devices to share files and photos, hand off tasks, and even control your iPhone from your Mac.
Copy images, video, or text from an app on your iPhone or iPad. Then paste into another app on your nearby Mac — or vice versa.
See and use what’s on your iPhone from your Mac — even if you’re charging your phone in another room. And your iPhone stays locked, so no one else can access it or see what you’re doing.
You don’t have to reach for your phone to stay in the know. Live Activities from your iPhone now appear on your Mac — like when your Uber Eats order is about to arrive.
Sign, annotate, and sketch on iPad or iPhone — live updates appear instantly on your Mac, and you can easily insert them into any document.

_lines._intent: 换到 Mac：从 PC/Mac 迁移与长期使用的五项安心事实

_action.label: Learn more about switching from Windows PC to Mac

_detail.text: Easily move files, apps, and more from your old PC or Mac with Migration Assistant. Or quickly set up your Mac using your iPhone or iPad with Mac Setup Assistant. If you need any help, Apple Support is always just an online chat, phone call, or in-store appointment away.
iCloud lets you store all your photos, contacts, and documents so they’re available on all your devices. Start a to-do list on your iPhone and check off items on your MacBook Air — and so much more.
Mac comes with apps like FaceTime, Freeform, and Keynote that let you get to work creating and collaborating on your next big idea.
Made with durable recycled aluminum enclosures, Mac laptops are ready for just about anything. And free macOS software updates help your Mac work reliably and securely for years to come.
Never used a Mac? No problem. Switching to Mac from PC is quick and easy.

_name.text: Made with 55% recycled material by weight.

_detail.text: Our approach. Using recycled materials, like 100% recycled cobalt in the battery, reduces the need to mine new material, which avoids the carbon emissions and environmental impacts of mining.

Our approach. Using electricity from renewable sources like wind and solar across our global supply chain — instead of fossil fuels — significantly reduces carbon emissions from manufacturing Apple products.
Our approach. MacBook Air comes in a 100% fiber-based box as part of our commitment to remove plastic from the packaging of all Apple products.
